name: China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd.
summary: China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd. engages in the investment, construction, operation, and management of nuclear power projects in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in the heat production and supply; nuclear, new energy, and other power generation; Nuclear energy utilization and development; and provision of technical services.
